spec.notes: Revision 2 (2026-10-03, results review r1 B1): narrowed to link 2. Revision 1 also declared link 1 through test_wraps_prediction_with_heartbeat_watchdog, whose assertion counts a call of the watchdog helper the test replaces with nullcontext(): a call count that observes no heartbeat or watchdog output, diagnostic_only under design §9.2. Link 2: at the parent (77b36f5) _run_shadow_prediction never checks for an existing shadow pick, so it dispatches the patched predict_local_shadow and mock_predict.assert_not_called() raises AssertionError (line 72, unique). This witnesses the no-repeat dispatch decision, not the training cost itself. Revision 1 and its outputs are kept (historical_replay/specs-superseded/R-I047-1.r1.json, results-f453283/R-I047-1.r1-superseded). Revision 1's notes: Link 1: at the parent (77b36f5), _run_shadow_prediction calls predict_local_shadow without heartbeat_watchdog, so the patched watchdog is never called and mock_watchdog.assert_called_once_with(...) raises AssertionError (line 48 at 150ed4c, unique). Link 2: the parent never checks for an existing shadow pick, so it calls the patched predict_local_shadow, and mock_predict.assert_not_called() raises AssertionError (line 72, unique). In that test the MagicMock predictions make the parent's real select_pick return None at `if predictions.empty`, and the function returns normally. Both AssertionErrors come from unittest.mock; the runner's innermost repo frame (venv excluded) is the test line. All other work in the parent's function runs inside its broad `except Exception`, so no other exception can surface. Static checks: _run_shadow_prediction(config, date, production_pick_name) keeps its signature at the parent; the module's autouse fixture patches bts.strategy._load_mdp, which exists there. In the first test the parent also runs the real attach_provenance on the MagicMock daily, exactly as F does.
